_published_faq.name: How do I add Ticketmaster to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ticketmaster to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://partner-mcp.ticketmaster.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Ticketmaster MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 5, 2026, Ticketmaster scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ticketmaster MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ticketmaster provides these MCP tools: find_tickets and unified_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ticketmaster?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Ticketmaster in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Ticketmaster does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Ticketmaster failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ticketmaster scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is Authenticated MCP access is available. Reconnect the server account or provide a valid refreshable OAuth session, then rerun the audit. Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
